case: pg_lsn[] binary decode, inferred binding, keyed update, and CSV restore
contract: Binary pg_lsn[] results preserve the full unsigned 64-bit range, SQL NULL and non-default lower bounds.
Assignment-inferred bindings encode each pg_lsn element in PostgreSQL binary form and retain native array_send bytes.
Keyed updates use the static pg_catalog.pg_lsn[] cast, preserve native type and values, and leave the sibling row unchanged.
Typed CSV import restores pg_lsn[] with matching type, text and native wire bytes.
Malformed LSN text is refused before mutation; decoder/encoder boundaries cover both halves and malformed input.
The built-in OID census now includes pg_lsn element OID 3220; the remaining unlisted built-ins still refuse explicitly.
